spec.name: au_resident_tax_2026_27
spec.summary: Australia, resident for the full 2026-27 year: income tax on taxable income less LITO, plus 2% Medicare levy, plus MLS check; take-home = gross income less those.

has_salary_or_wage_income.description: does the person earn salary or wages (labour income)? The engine then applies the $1,000 standard work deduction top-up itself

labour_income.description: AUD qualifying labour income (salary and wages) within gross_income; business or PSI income does not count. Taken as gross_income when not given

actual_work_expenses_claimed.description: work-related expenses the person chooses to claim with records

has_private_hospital_cover.description: private patient hospital cover for the full year

tax_year.description: the tax year the question is about, written YYYY-YY. This engine has figures for 2026-27 only; any other year is refused

anchors: au-deductions-offsets example: TI $88,340 -> gross tax $17,022, Medicare $1,766.80

rules.name: LITO
rules.section: Individual income tax / Offsets and deductions
rules.quote: LITO | $700 to $37,500; taper 5c/$1 to $45,000; then 1.5c/$1 to nil at $66,667

rules.name: MEDICARE_LOW_INCOME_SINGLE_2026_27
rules.quote: 2026-27 Medicare levy. The current Act sets the single non-SAPTO threshold at $28,011, with phase-in up to $35,013.

rules.name: STANDARD_WRE_DEDUCTION
rules.section: Individual income tax / Offsets and deductions
rules.quote: $1,000 standard WRE deduction | From 2026-27, an individual resident at any time in the year with qualifying assessable labour income can receive a top-up: max(0, min($1,000, that labour income) minus specified labour-related deductions). Business/PSI income alone does not qualify
